stdout: By type: File 2, Event 1, Key 1, Section 1
Handle              Type            Access      Cnt  Ptr  Object
(unnamed) = the descriptor records no name; (unreadable) = a name was recorded but the bounded read failed
Rights decode each row's own Access mask against its recorded object type -- the same bit means
different things for a File, a Process and a Token. A long list splits into Type (rights that
object type defines) and Standard (the rights every type shares). They are an observation about
what the handle permitted, never evidence that it was used.
Each display name maps to one Windows SDK, WDK or native constant, and what that constant
contains depends on the object type it was read against.
Event  AllAccess        = QueryState · ModifyState · Delete · ReadControl · WriteDac ·
File   FileGenericRead  = ReadData · ReadEa · ReadAttributes · ReadControl · Synchronize
File   FileGenericWrite = WriteData · AppendData · WriteEa · WriteAttributes · ReadControl ·
Key    KeyRead          = QueryValue · EnumerateSubKeys · Notify · ReadControl
